name: workflow
description: GitHub-issue-native delivery pipeline: /project-kit (labels + conventions + domain docs) -> /spec (grilled PRD as a parent issue) -> /taskplan (dependency-linked sub-issues) -> /implement (1 parent = 1 worktree = 1 branch = 1 PR; graph-walking orchestrator, subagent or --orca terminal workers, implement-core doctrine) -> /cleanup (PR, CI, merge, close parent, teardown) -> /stats (per-stage token cost, rolled up at cleanup). Plus /triage for inbound raw issues, and the grilling + domain-modeling engines (CONTEXT.md glossary, minimal ADRs).
